title: The mark-failed path frees the comment with unclaimComment(claimId), which deletes any posted=false row for the comment, not its own claim row
evidence: app/lib/youtube-bot-post.server.ts postClaimed: when markPosting answered 'failed' it called releasePostingMark (row- and token-scoped), then unclaimComment(claimId), scoped to the comment only. Between those calls another machine could insert a fresh posted=false claim; unclaimComment deleted it too, wasting that machine's model call (never a double post). Done: unclaimComment(commentId, claimRowId) also matches the row id; all five callers pass the id claimComment returned (US-27 AC5a). Found in the C15 follow-up (PR 1372 review)
